entities.name: Ruins of Caerdoon
entities.description: The remains of an ancient fortress in Orrithia on Arcavios, steeped in necromantic energy from a long-forgotten battle.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane containing the Ruins of Caerdoon.

entities.name: Orrithia
entities.description: The region of Arcavios where the ruins lie.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: The college that conducts rare archaeological surveys of the ruins.

entities.name: Murgaxor Grenshel
entities.description: The figure tracked down and defeated in the fortress basement by fourth-year Strixhaven students.

entities.name: Strixhaven students
entities.description: A party that defeated Murgaxor Grenshel.

events.summary: A long-forgotten battle at Caerdoon kills hundreds and leaves the ground steeped in necromantic energy.
events.quote: a long-forgotten battle in which hundreds perished

events.summary: More recently a large-scale necromantic ritual at the fortress tried to achieve immortality.
events.quote: a large-scale necromantic ritual that harnessed the death-saturated land in an attempt to achieve immortality

events.summary: A party of fourth-year Strixhaven students tracks down and defeats Murgaxor Grenshel in the fortress basement.
events.quote: This is where Murgaxor Grenshel was tracked down and defeated by a party of fourth-year Strixhaven students.
